name: Hôtel Fabric
summary: A former textile factory between République and Bastille, with 33 rooms and a 4-star listing from the hotel.
description: Hôtel Fabric occupies a former textile factory at 31 rue de la Folie Méricourt, in the 11th, between République and Bastille. The hotel says the house has 33 rooms on four floors and files itself as a 4-star, with an interior drawn from the workshop past of Oberkampf: brick, volume, and large windows. It looks like a much louder luxury hotel. The rate printed here is the Club Double Room Ground Floor Booking.com showed for two adults on 10–11 November 2026. On that night it sits above the $80–150 hunt, and it is printed because the page was open.
